target.definition: The total value of New Zealand's goods exports in March 2026, actual monthly value not seasonally adjusted, as first reported in Stats NZ's monthly Overseas merchandise trade release.

inputs.name: annual_goods_exports_nzd
inputs.description: New Zealand's total annual goods export value around the estimation period.

provenance.rationale: Recent NZ goods exports have been roughly in the 70-80 billion NZD annual range, with uncertainty from prices and trade volumes.

inputs.name: march_share_of_annual_exports
inputs.description: Share of annual goods export value that falls in March, reflecting March seasonality and day count.

provenance.rationale: March is near a simple one-twelfth share but can be above average because of dairy season timing and 31 days.

inputs.name: dairy_export_value_march_nzd
inputs.description: Value of New Zealand dairy goods exports in March 2026.

provenance.rationale: Dairy is a large seasonal export category; monthly values vary with dairy prices and peak production flows.

inputs.name: non_dairy_export_value_march_nzd
inputs.description: Value of New Zealand non-dairy goods exports in March 2026.

provenance.rationale: Non-dairy goods exports include meat, forestry, machinery, fruit, seafood and other goods, with substantial monthly variation.

inputs.name: annual_gdp_nzd
inputs.description: New Zealand annual nominal GDP around the estimation period.

provenance.rationale: Nominal GDP is roughly in the low 400 billions NZD, with uncertainty from growth and price deflators.

inputs.name: goods_exports_share_of_gdp
inputs.description: Goods exports as a share of nominal GDP.

provenance.rationale: New Zealand goods exports have historically been around one-sixth of nominal GDP, varying with commodity prices and exchange rates.

inputs.name: months_per_year
inputs.description: Number of months in a year used to convert an annual value to an average monthly value.

inputs.name: march_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Factor scaling an average month to an actual March value.

provenance.rationale: March can be above or below the average month depending on export timing, with a modest upward tilt from dairy season and 31 days.

paths.description: Allocate an annual goods export total to March using a March share of annual exports.
Add estimated March values for dairy and non-dairy goods exports.
Use GDP times goods export intensity as an annual export proxy, divide to a monthly average, then scale to March.
